descriptions.checkAiSettings: Check the AI: availability, which model does what, Beebot
descriptions.checkLicense: Check license and API operation usage
descriptions.installOnlineInvokers: Install API definitions from the OpenCelium online repository
descriptions.ldapCheck: Open the LDAP connectivity check page
descriptions.workflow: Search the current workflow or show where things are
descriptions.createWorkflow: Create a new workflow: empty, from a template or generated with AI
descriptions.workflowShow: Show where a method's URL, headers or body are, or how to try it
descriptions.workflowShowUrl: Show where the URL of a method is (the selected one, or name it)
descriptions.workflowShowHeaders: Show where the headers of a method are (the selected one, or name it)
descriptions.workflowShowBody: Show where the body of a method is (the selected one, or name it)
descriptions.workflowShowTry: Show how to try a method, i.e. send one test request to it (the selected one, or name it)
descriptions.workflowShowTransformation: Show how to apply a transformation (a script) to a value in a method's body or headers
descriptions.workflowAddMethod: Add a new method from a connector to the workflow, before or after a step
descriptions.workflowSuggestMapping: Suggest references (a mapping) for the body of a method from the response of an earlier method
descriptions.workflowApplyTransformation: Apply a transformation (a script) to a property of the open body or headers
descriptions.workflowOpenBody: Open the body of a method now (the selected one, or name it)
descriptions.workflowOpenHeaders: Open the headers of a method now (the selected one, or name it)
descriptions.workflowTestRun: Start a test run of the whole workflow, live or in debug mode (test, run, execute or debug the workflow)
descriptions.workflowStopTest: Stop the test run that is going
descriptions.workflowExplainFailure: Explain why the last test run failed (what went wrong, which error)
descriptions.workflowFixFailure: Fix it: propose a fix for the step that failed in the last test run (repair the error)
descriptions.workflowApplyFix: Apply the proposed AI fix to the failed step (apply it, take it over)
descriptions.workflowExplain: Explain what this whole workflow does, step by step
descriptions.workflowShowLogs: Show the logs of the test run
descriptions.workflowShowProblems: Show the problems of this workflow (errors and warnings found while editing)
descriptions.workflowAddOperator: Add an IF (run the next steps only if / only when a condition holds) or a loop (for each item of a list), before or after a step
descriptions.workflowUndo: Undo the last change to the workflow
descriptions.workflowRedo: Redo the change that was undone
descriptions.workflowDeleteStep: Remove a step from the workflow (delete it)
descriptions.workflowGenerate: Build a new workflow with AI from a description of what it should do
descriptions.workflowStartTutorial: Start the tutorial of the workflow editor (it opens on a new workflow and changes nothing here)

wakeWord.start: Talk to {{name}}: once on, it listens all the time and acts only on what starts with “{{name}}”, e.g. “{{name}}, where is the header of the method?”. Everything else is ignored.
wakeWord.autoStopped: {{name}} stopped listening after {{count}} minutes without a request.

workflowEdit.notEditable: The workflow cannot be changed right now (read-only, or a test run is going on).
workflowEdit.noConnectors: There are no connectors to add a method from. Create a connector first.
workflowEdit.unknownConnector: No connector of yours matches the one you named.
workflowEdit.noPlace: There is no place for a method there.
workflowEdit.failed: The AI could not read the request. Try again, or add the method with “+”.
workflowEdit.sameMethod: Name two different methods: one whose body gets the references, one they come from.
workflowEdit.unknownStep: No method in this workflow matches “{{method}}”.
workflowEdit.mappingFailed: The AI could not read the request. Try again, or open the method's body and use AI mapping.
workflowEdit.noOpenEditor: Open the body or the headers of a method first: a transformation applies to the request open there.
workflowEdit.noFields: The open {{part}} has no properties to transform.
workflowEdit.unknownField: No property of the open {{part}} matches “{{field}}”.
workflowEdit.noFieldNamed: Name the property, or select it in the {{part}} first.
workflowEdit.noReference: {{field}} holds no reference: a transformation changes a value taken from another method. Insert a reference first.
workflowEdit.noScriptDescription: Say what the transformation should do, e.g. “with convert it to upper case”.
workflowEdit.transformationFailed: The AI could not read the request. Try again, or describe the script in the transformation panel.

workflowAssist.testRunning: A test run is already going. Say “stop the test” to end it.
workflowAssist.testUnavailable: The test run cannot start right now: the connection to the server is not ready, or another test of this workflow is running.
workflowAssist.noFailure: There is no failed test run. Start one with “test the workflow”.
workflowAssist.notFixable: Only a failed method call can be fixed. Ask why it failed instead.
workflowAssist.noFix: There is no proposed fix to apply. Ask for a fix first.
workflowAssist.noSteps: Add steps first, then ask what the workflow does.
workflowAssist.nothingToUndo: There is nothing to undo right now.
workflowAssist.nothingToRedo: There is nothing to redo right now.
workflowAssist.cannotSave: The workflow cannot be saved right now (read-only, nothing changed, or the save dialog is already open).
workflowAssist.deleteWhich: Name the step to remove, or select it first.
workflowAssist.tutorialUnavailable: The tutorial is available to administrators only.
workflowAssist.generateUnavailable: Generate with AI is not available right now.
workflowAssist.operatorFailed: The AI could not read the request. Try again, or add the IF or loop with “+”.
workflowAssist.ifAdded: Added an IF. Its condition is being built from “{{condition}}”: check it and save.
workflowAssist.ifAddedEmpty: Added an IF. Describe its condition in the dialog.
workflowAssist.loopAdded: Added a loop. Choose the list to loop over in the dialog.

confirmLogout.title: Sign out
confirmLogout.message: Are you sure you want to sign out?

workflowTemplateJsonEdit.description: Workflow templates can now be edited directly as JSON from the template list.

enhancementScriptSandbox.description: Run an enhancement script in the browser against sample input before saving it.

workflowReferenceOperations.description: References can now use operations on the response: any property (*), all key names, the last array element and the number of elements. Type an operation's syntax to jump to it.

workflowConnectorHttpMethod.title: Change HTTP method
workflowConnectorHttpMethod.description: The HTTP method can now be changed for connector methods too, not only for HTTP request and webhook steps.

workflowHeaderUserActions.description: Language, help with the workflow tutorial, the menu switch and your profile are now available right in the editor header.

workflowTestMethod.title: Try Request
workflowTestMethod.description: Send this method on its own, with values for its references to previous methods, without running the whole workflow. Still in development: responses are mock data for now.

workflowProblems.title: Automatic Workflow Check
workflowProblems.description: The workflow is now checked as you edit. Errors and warnings are counted here; click to see every problem and jump to the step it is on.

sidebarBackToMainMenu.title: Back to main menu
sidebarBackToMainMenu.description: Back returns you to the main menu, on the page you last had open there. Alt+M switches between the two menus as well.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.description: See what changed in each OpenCelium release: the current version first, earlier ones below. Open it from the help menu.

workflowAiAssistant.title: AI assistant
workflowAiAssistant.description: Generate a workflow from your own words, have it explained, or turn on Beebot and just say what you need. It runs locally, nothing leaves this machine.

credentialEditor.updateWithoutMasterPassword: You can save without entering the master password — only the general data will be updated. To change the required credentials, enter the master password first.
credentialEditor.masterPasswordNotConfigured: You can save without a master password — only the general data will be updated. To change the required credentials, ask an administrator to set opencelium.connector.master-password in /backend/src/main/resources/application.yml and restart the backend.
